summary: Regression testing of GymAxis marketing pages and cross-module navigation after iteration 167 edits. All 6 test areas passed: (1) Homepage loads cleanly with tech-stack marquee REMOVED; (2) Pricing page shows 4 tiers including new Bundle offer with cyan theming and 'Best value' badge; (3) Features and Security pages load with dark theme and cyan accents, no white-text-on-white-bg issues; (4) ModuleSwitcher navigates correctly between Pulse/Memberships/MOD; (5) Memberships console shows App URL card with phone-frame brand preview and working copy-to-clipboard button; (6) Footer links route correctly with no 404s.
